Diploma In Computerized Industrial Accounting(DCIA) (1 Year)This program provides in-depth training in modern accounting practices using computerized tools. It covers financial accounting, taxation, payroll management, GST, and accounting software like Tally and Excel, preparing students for careers in finance, accounting, and business administration.

Advanced Diploma In Accounts And Financial Marketing(ADAFM) (1Year)A comprehensive program that blends advanced accounting skills with financial marketing concepts. It equips students with expertise in financial analysis, digital accounting tools, taxation, and modern marketing strategies, preparing them for careers in finance, accounting, and business development.

Diploma In Indian And Foreign Accounting (6Months)This course provides practical training in both Indian and international accounting systems. It covers financial accounting, GST, income tax, and global accounting standards using software like Tally and Excel, preparing students for careers in domestic and overseas accounting fields.

Diploma In Financial Accounting (3Months)A practical course that provides essential knowledge of financial accounting, bookkeeping, GST, taxation, and accounting software like Tally and Excel. It prepares students for entry-level roles in accounting, finance, and office administration.

Advanced Diploma In Multimedia And Animation(ADMA) (18Months)A creative and career-focused program covering graphic design, 2D & 3D animation, visual effects, video editing, and multimedia production. It equips students with industry-ready skills to work in animation studios, advertising, film, gaming, and digital media.

Digital Graphics Course (8Months)A Digital Graphics course introduces students to the principles and tools used to create visual content for digital media. It covers topics like image editing, illustration, color theory, typography, and design workflows using software such as Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator. Digital Film Making Course (8Months)A Digital Filmmaking Course teaches students how to create films using modern digital tools and techniques. It covers the entire filmmaking process—story development, scripting, cinematography, directing, sound recording, editing, visual effects, and distribution. Students learn to use professional equipment and software, gaining hands-on experience in producing

Web Designing Course (8Months)A Web Designing Course teaches you how to create visually appealing, user-friendly, and responsive websites. You learn essential skills like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, layout design, UI/UX principles, and modern tools to build professional websites. It’s ideal for beginners or anyone looking to start a career in web design or front-end development.

Design And Advertising Course (12Months)A Design and Advertising course introduces students to the creative and strategic processes behind visual communication and brand promotion. It covers fundamentals of graphic design, branding, typography, layout, and digital tools, while also exploring advertising concepts such as campaign planning, target audiences, and messaging. Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Applications(PGDCA)A one-year program that provides advanced knowledge of computer applications, covering programming, database management, software development, web technologies, and computer networks. It prepares students for careers in IT, software, and administrative roles requiring strong computer skills.

Diploma in Computer Applications(DCA)A foundational computer course that covers essential skills such as MS Office, internet basics, typing, data management, and introductory software applications. It prepares students for office work, administrative roles, and further studies in computer-related fields.

Desktop Publishing Course (DTP)A desktop publishing course teaches students how to use software tools like Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Microsoft Publisher to create professional-quality print and digital documents. MS Office CourseMS Office Course (Short Description)An MS Office course provides practical training in essential Microsoft applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Learners gain skills in creating documents, managing data using spreadsheets, designing presentations, and handling professional email communication. Professional Diploma in Desktop Publishing(PDDTP)A practical course that trains students in layout design, typography, image editing, and publishing tools. It prepares learners to create brochures, posters, magazines, and other print/digital materials using professional DTP software.

Certificate in Web Programming & Development Essentials(CWPDE)A beginner-friendly course that teaches the essentials of creating and editing web pages using HTML, CSS, and basic design tools. It prepares students to build visually appealing, responsive, and user-friendly websites.

Professional Diploma In Computerized Financial Accounting(PDCFA)A practical program that trains students in modern financial accounting using computerized tools. It covers bookkeeping, GST, taxation, payroll, and software like Tally and Excel, preparing learners for accounting and office administration roles.

Beautician CourseA practical training program that teaches skincare, haircare, makeup techniques, grooming, and salon management. It prepares students to work as professional beauticians in salons, spas, and beauty centers or start their own beauty business.

Fashion Designing CourseA fashion designing course teaches the skills needed to create clothing and accessories, from sketching ideas to producing finished garments. Students learn about design principles, fabrics, pattern making, sewing techniques, fashion trends, and industry practices. The course helps develop creativity, technical ability, and an understanding of how the fashion industry works

Pre-primary TTC A foundational program that prepares aspiring teachers to work with young children. It covers child psychology, early childhood education methods, classroom management, and creative teaching techniques, enabling trainees to effectively teach and care for pre-primary students.

Graphic Designing CourseA graphic designing course teaches students how to create visual content using design principles and digital tools.
